collect._planRouteNote: REQ-053 GP-NFR-040 / WP 5.4: the garden plan route is measured next to the root. It is the field-mode URL (`?mode=field`), the mode a phone gets by default, so the lazily loaded GardenPlanRoute chunk is fetched. Honest scope: this runs over the static ./dist with no backend, so the page behind the chunk is the app's error surface (no tenant, no plan) - what the audit certifies for this URL is the route chunk's weight, the shell's accessibility and the mobile budgets, not a rendered plan. A rendered, authenticated plan needs the E2E stack (Lighthouse's puppeteerScript against `docker-compose.e2e.yml`); that is not wired. The plan's own bundle budget stays `routeChunks.gardenPlanner` in bundle-budget.json. LHCI's JSON parser tolerates unknown keys, so this note is auditable in-file.

assert._baselineNote: categories:accessibility uses a computed baseline-and-ratchet floor (NFR-018 §2.1 — computed, not versioned). Measured 2026-08-09 over the static ./dist SPA, 3 mobile runs: accessibility = 0.98 on all three runs (only the heading-order audit is imperfect; the audit is deterministic, not timing-flaky). Floor set to 0.98 at error so the app passes today and any real a11y regression turns the assertion red. Ratchet the floor up as the score improves; lower it only with a recorded reason. performance stays warn (report-only). LHCI ignores unknown keys under assert, so this note is auditable in-file; JSONC // comments are NOT tolerated by the LHCI JSON parser.
